Maya G: quick heads-up — our sampleapp rerank pipeline is failing for a small subset of requests today
Samir: what failure mode?
Maya G: mismatch between vector dims in response and what client expects. we batch 3 queries -> helper merges into one request, response comes back with mixed dim vectors (512 + 768) and our SDK assumes a single dim, so downstream numpy reshape crashes
Jordan: are you on sherpa-sdk v0.8.1 or the 0.8.2 beta? there was a retry dedupe fix in 0.8.2 that also touches batch slicing
Maya G: v0.8.1 sadly
Samir: also noticed an auth refresh flap where token refresh triggers an in-flight retry; duplicate payloads hit rerank and we get re-ordered outputs
Maya G: repro is pretty small: run sampleapp with minimal data, call /v1/rerank with 3 items, helper uses auto-batching -> sometimes order flips and dims mismatch
Maya G: minimal snippet we hit:
```json
{"input_ids":["q1","q2","q3"], "batching":true}
```
Samir: then response looks like:
```json
{"vectors":[[0.1, ... (512 floats) ...],[0.2, ... (768 floats) ...],[0.3, ... (512 floats) ...]], "order":[2,0,1]}
```
Samir: SDK code was doing `reshape(-1, expected_dim)` which explodes
Jordan: workaround until patch: validate dims per-vector and raise an early error + log raw response. also set `preserve_order=true` in the batcher config if you need stable ordering
Maya G: made a quick local patch to helper that rejects mixed-dim batches and falls back to per-item calls — reduces throughput but safe
Jordan: opened PR with a proper fix (validation + idempotent retry guard): https://github.com/redwood-inference/sherpa/pull/42 :thumbsup:
DevEx Bot: deploy scheduled to canary at 2025-07-02T14:12:00Z
Maya G: also discovered sampleapp onboarding docs don't mention the `vec_dim` contract explicitly — people assume homogenous dims
Samir: I'll add an integration test that simulates auth latency: `AUTH_LATENCY=2000 make test-integration` to catch the retry race
Jordan: note for eng-runtime — could kernel selection/quantization paths produce different output sizes under some model variants? if model variants are swapped by smart routing, client-facing dims could change
Maya G: good call. filing runtime ticket with trace logs so we can see if model_variant fallback correlates with these bad responses
ops-bot: incident-tag: dx-embed-shape; severity: low; owner: devex
Maya G: thanks, filing follow-ups: 1) doc update, 2) sampleapp test, 3) sdk patch backport to 0.8.1, 4) runtime trace review. ping @Jordan if you want to pair tomorrow
Samir: pairing ok, I can demo the failing trace
Maya G: ok wrapping up here — tl;dr: mixed-dim responses + auth-retry duplicates -> SDK reshape crash; temporary fix = client-side dim check + preserve_order; PR linked for proper patch.
